title: offer.effective-price.changed
description: The offer's effective UAH price (base price after the account's discount, FX and markup) changed. Emitted by the offer service when a supplier price change or an account-terms change moves the effective price. Topic: sa.offer.effective-price, key: offer_id.

offer_id.description: ULID of the Offer (supplier_account x supplier_product)

supplier_account_id.description: ULID of the account whose terms produced this price

supplier_product_id.description: ULID of the product this offer prices

old_effective_price_uah.description: Previous effective UAH price as a decimal string; null on first pricing

new_effective_price_uah.description: New effective UAH price as a decimal string (never float)

base_price.description: Supplier base price this effective price was computed from, in `currency`

currency.description: ISO-4217 code of `base_price` (the account settlement currency)

observed_at.description: When the input that moved the effective price was observed (base price observation, or terms change time)

cause.description: What moved the effective price: a supplier base-price change or an account-terms change
